description: This is an Android Fragment class 'AppRestrictionSchemaFragment' that manages application restrictions based on device policies. It interacts with the RestrictionsManager to retrieve and display restrictions, and includes UI components such as buttons and text views to present restriction states and respond to user interactions.

classes.name: AppRestrictionSchemaFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays and manages app restrictions using RestrictionsManager, updating UI based on restrictions, and handling button clicks to show restriction-specific messages.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets click listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resolves and updates restriction states when fragment resumes.

methods.name: resolveRestrictions
methods.description: Retrieves restrictions from RestrictionsManager and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateCanSayHello
methods.description: Updates the 'can say hello' restriction state and enables/disables button.

methods.name: updateMessage
methods.description: Updates the message based on restrictions.

methods.name: updateNumber
methods.description: Updates the number display based on restrictions.

methods.name: updateRank
methods.description: Updates the rank display based on restrictions.

methods.name: updateApprovals
methods.description: Updates permissions approvals display based on restrictions.

methods.name: updateItems
methods.description: Updates the list of items restriction if supported.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button click to show a toast message with the message restriction.
